# Apex Development Studio LLC

> Veteran-owned independent software studio in Aldie, Virginia (Northern Virginia). Designs and ships native iOS and Android apps and mission-driven websites. Founded by Joe McMullin, a retired U.S. Army Master Sergeant with nearly two decades in enterprise and federal IT.

## Services
- iOS, iPadOS and macOS apps: Swift, SwiftUI, HealthKit, CloudKit, StoreKit 2
- Android apps: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Health Connect, Play Billing
- Websites for mission-driven organizations: research, brand, copy, build and hosting

## Work
- [Journey Tracker](https://journeytracker.app): GLP-1 therapy and weight-loss companion for iPhone, iPad and Mac; live on the App Store. Health data stays on the user's devices and their own iCloud.
- [Gleaming Beacon](https://gleamingbeacon.com): personal life-alignment app for iOS and Android, coming soon. All charts are computed on the device.
- [HINA — Humanitarian Initiative for Native Advancement](https://hinapacific.org): client website, built end to end.
